title: Pendulum energy relay
summary: A passive pendulum (a rod with a ball-shaped bob) hangs between the two arms, each of which holds a flat paddle. The left arm must actively push the pendulum so that it swings out toward the right arm. The right arm must meet it and brake it, then actively drive it back so that it swings out toward the left arm, no longer touching it. The left arm must then touch it again, and the pendulum must end up hanging almost straight down and almost still, and stay that way for one second.
robot_setup: Two Pandas facing each other along x. panda-0 (left): base at (-0.55, -0.22, 0), yaw 0 (facing +x). panda-1 (right): base at (0.74, 0.22, 0), yaw pi (facing -x). Each hand carries the same rigid 'fork' paddle: one flat vertical blade, 12 mm thick, 0.14 m wide (2 x `tool_half`, 0.07 at this instance) and 50 mm tall. A grey adapter (a horizontal bar from the hand and a short post) ends about 5 cm behind the blade on the hand side; blade and adapter form one rigid tool link. The tool frame is the centre of the blade: x is the blade normal (pointing away from the arm's own base), y runs along the blade's width, z is up. With the tool level the hand points straight down and the blade centre is 0.12 m ahead of the gripper TCP along tool x and 0.04 m below it. Start: left tool frame at (-0.04, -0.02, 0.21), axes aligned with the world (blade normal +x); right tool frame at (0.28, 0.02, 0.21), rotated 180 deg about z (blade normal -x, facing the left arm). Both arms use a slower motion profile than the default: the joint trajectory generator is limited to 20 % of the Panda's acceleration limits and 1 % of its jerk limits (default 55 % and 5 %), and wrist joints 5-7 use higher damping gains (24, 20, 14 instead of 12, 10, 7). Role labels per phase (left, right): left_excitation: exciter, preparing_brake; right_braking: cleared_exciter, brake; right_return_impulse: preparing_receiver, return_driver; left_recovery: brake, cleared_driver; low_energy_hold: damping_support, cleared_partner.
scene: A passive pendulum hangs between the two arms from a grey stand: a blue rod (18 mm square cross-section, 0.22 m from the hinge to the bob centre) ending in an orange ball-shaped bob (radius 26 mm). Its hinge axis is horizontal and parallel to world y, so it swings in the vertical x-z plane, toward one arm or the other. The hinge has no motor, no friction and no damping, so once set swinging the pendulum keeps swinging until something takes the energy out. The stand (a horizontal bearing arm reaching to the hinge and an upright post down to the table, plus a small blue block just under the hinge) lies on the +y side of the swing plane, leaving the swing plane open. At t = 0 the pendulum hangs almost straight down and almost at rest. There is nothing else in the scene. The table top is the world's z = 0 plane.
scene_privileged: Pendulum: articulation with a fixed base; hinge (pivot) at (0.12, 0, 0.43), revolute axis world +y, joint limits [-1.45, 1.45] rad, no friction, damping or drive. Rod length `length` = 0.22 m, bob radius 0.026 m (friction 0.5, restitution 0.05); the swinging link's total mass (rod + bob) is `object_mass` = 0.075 kg. Sign convention: with hinge angle q the bob centre is at pivot + (-`length` sin q, 0, -`length` cos q), so q < 0 swings the bob toward +x (the right arm) and q > 0 toward -x (the left arm); at q = 0 the bob centre is at (0.12, 0, 0.21) (this is the announced `goal_target`). At reset two values are drawn from the instance's random stream, in this order: q0 ~ U(-`initial_angle_range`, +`initial_angle_range`) = U(-0.015, 0.015) rad and q0_dot ~ U(-`initial_angular_speed_range`, +`initial_angular_speed_range`) = 0 rad/s at nominal; nothing else is random and nothing is drawn later. Stand: grey upright post (24 mm square) at (0.12, 0.16) from z = 0.43 down to the table, a horizontal bearing arm (24 mm square) at z = 0.43 from the post to the pivot, and a 40 x 40 x 30 mm block centred 35 mm below the pivot. Thresholds: `minimum_excursion` = 0.18 rad, `return_excursion` = 0.12 rad. Paddles: mass `tool_mass` = 0.2 kg each, friction `tool_friction` = 0.3, restitution 0.05. Horizon `horizon` = 25 s.

phases.name: left_excitation
phases.text: the left paddle (any part of panda-0's tool link) touches the pendulum while that tool's centre-of-mass speed is above 0.03 m/s (an active push, recorded once); after that, the pendulum swings out toward the right arm beyond `minimum_excursion` = 0.18 rad (about 10.3 deg) from straight down, i.e. hinge angle q < -0.18 rad, bob displaced toward +x. The paddle may or may not still be touching the pendulum at that moment.

phases.name: right_braking
phases.text: the right paddle (any part of panda-1's tool link) touches the pendulum at a moment when the pendulum's angular speed about its hinge is below 0.45 rad/s.

phases.name: right_return_impulse
phases.text: the right paddle touches the pendulum while that tool's centre-of-mass speed is above 0.03 m/s (an active push, recorded once in this phase); after that, at a moment when the right paddle is not touching the pendulum, the pendulum is beyond `return_excursion` = 0.12 rad (about 6.9 deg) toward the left arm (q > 0.12 rad, bob displaced toward -x) and is still swinging further toward the left arm at more than 0.25 rad/s (dq/dt > +0.25 rad/s).

phases.name: left_recovery
phases.text: the left paddle touches the pendulum (any contact).

phases.name: low_energy_hold
phases.text: the pendulum is within 0.055 rad (about 3.2 deg) of hanging straight down (|q| < 0.055 rad) and its angular speed is below 0.12 rad/s, for 1.0 s without interruption. Paddle contact with the pendulum is allowed during the hold. This completes the task.

contact_rules: Each paddle (blade and adapter, one rigid tool link) may touch only the swinging part of the pendulum (rod and bob). Neither paddle may touch the pendulum's stand (bearing arm, post, block under the hinge), the table or anything else. No other part of either robot, the fingers included, may touch anything. The two arms and their paddles may never touch each other, and no arm may touch itself.
world_goals_seeded: `goal_target`, the bob centre's hanging-rest point, is announced at reset in the state. It does not depend on the seed, but it gives away the pendulum's location: privileged mode only. The predicates use only the hinge angle and the angular speed, not this point. The seeded initial angle is not announced.
difficulty_note: All energy has to be put into and taken out of a free, undamped pendulum through brief contacts with flat paddles. Each push must be timed to the swing, the right arm must stop the swing and then reverse it and let go, and the left arm must finally absorb the swing almost completely, all under a deliberately slow, low-jerk motion profile.
standard_notes: At t = 0 the pendulum hangs nearly still, and nothing moves until a paddle touches it. Once excited it swings freely without damping until a paddle takes the energy out, so judge where it is in its swing from consecutive frames.
